title_zh: 核对虚构村民家史中的人物介绍

scenario.label_zh: 核对虚构村民家史中的人物介绍
scenario.goal_zh: 区分受访者本人及其丈夫的经历并约定改正人物归属并保留家庭种植经历

context_zh: 写作课编辑虚构村民家史。人物、家庭经历和作物均为练习设定，不涉及真实个人资料或真实战事。
author: author-phase12-c

sentences.speaker: Alma
sentences.text: This paragraph makes it sound as if the villager we interviewed served in the army.

sentences.speaker: Chris
sentences.text: She didn't. She's a widow; the veteran mentioned in her account was her husband.

sentences.speaker: Alma
sentences.text: So 'she returned from the war' is simply the wrong subject.

sentences.speaker: Chris
sentences.text: Yes. They later grew tobacco together, but that farming experience doesn't change who served.

sentences.speaker: Alma
sentences.text: I'll name her husband in the military-history sentence, then use 'they' for the farm.

sentences.speaker: Chris
sentences.text: Good. Keep her own memories of working there rather than turning the whole piece into his biography.

sentences.speaker: Alma
sentences.text: I will. The corrected paragraph should make both roles clear.
